input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 is the only IP ownership provision. Garman retaining ownership of the Work (Software and Documentation) and of Improvements and Modifications to it is acceptable — that is vendor platform ownership, and Sparkling holds a perpetual licence while fees are paid (17(a)) plus a perpetual escrow licence to use and change the Codes on Garman default or discontinued support (16(b)), which sits at the rule's fallback for deliverables. The material failure is the unqualified sweep of "all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement": that is not limited to Garman-provided items and on its face captures Sparkling's own materials, branding and the Sparkling data Garman converts under Section 4(b). There is no anywhere-in-the-document statement that Sparkling retains rights in its data (Section 14 treats data only as confidential information), so the walk-away risk of Customer IP/data passing to the Vendor is live. Redline limits the ownership sweep to Garman-provided materials and adds a Customer Data/materials ownership sentence with a no-joint-ownership confirmation; it does not disturb Garman's ownership of its Software.

proposal.summary: Limit Garman's IP ownership to Garman-provided materials and confirm Sparkling retains all rights in its own data and materials.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have limited Garman's ownership statement to materials Garman provides, and added a confirmation that Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in its own data (including data converted under Section 4) and materials. As drafted, "all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement" would sweep in our own data and branding, which our playbook does not permit; we are content for Garman to keep ownership of its Software, Documentation, Improvements and Modifications.

ops.oldText: logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
ops.newText: logos, and names provided by Garman pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement. Sparkling is and remains the owner of all right, title and interest (including all intellectual property rights) in and to Sparkling's data (including all data converted pursuant to Section 4) and all materials, logos, names and other information provided by Sparkling, and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns any such right to Garman or creates any joint ownership.
